title: Scam alert: playmix.ai
author: vurt72
selftext:
Often advertises here. Once you try the trial you can never cancel it, there is no option for it on the page.   
  
They use Stripe, and for a good reason;  
  
"To cancel a subscription made through Stripe, you must contact the business directly, as Stripe is not authorized to cancel subscriptions"

You can not contact [playmix.ai](http://playmix.ai) since they do not have either email, support or a telephone number. They have a Discord, which i am betting is just bot/bots.

replies.author: vurt72
replies.body:
contacted my bank directly when i noticed how shady it seemed.   
its a scam in the way that they hide away the option to cancel. no serious company would do that.  
  
 Also them making sure that no email is sent is another red flag, its because they hope the user will have no recollection of what he subscribed to, and then he can't even find an email of any type of subscription or anything else, he will have no clue who to contact, why money is being drawn etc. He can contact his bank but he will have nothing, he will not come off as very serious.

comments.author: Thomas-Lore
comments.body: Strangely enough I had the same issue with Apple TV (when registering new devices, like a TV, they ban you for suspicious activity locking you out of cancelling, my friend had a similar issue). Might be scam, might just be American company that does not know that cancelling is crucial.

comments.author: RealAstropulse
comments.body:
This is most of the "AI for game dev" sites made these days, because the entirety of their front end (and probably backend lol) is vibecoded. That's also why all of them look nearly identical with the same format and styling.

It's usually super easy to tell, because the sites do things that no 'good' thought out site would do, for example on playmix, their footer bar always gets shoved out of the way by the infinite scroll of games.

I wouldn't say the use of stripe is malicious, stripe is just one of the best online payment processors in general. You can always tell your bank to stop payment, most banks let you do that from the mobile app too.
